description: Check an .ipa, .apk or .aab on this computer without uploading it: the store readiness check (App Store and Google Play rules, each finding with a fix), why a phone would refuse to install it (signing, provisioning profile, bundle ID, test only, v1 only signature), and the Security scan counts. The file never leaves this computer. With a Pro or Team token the Security scan findings (masked secrets, MASVS category, fix) are included too. Guidance only, not a promise of store approval. Read only.
name: check_local_build
title: Check a local build before sharing
